learning_outcomes.text: Students will understand the fundamental concepts in structural dynamics and grasp the principles of free and forced vibrations.
Students will be able to produce analytical solutions using mathematical tools such as differential equations, matrix algebra, and Laplace transform in structural dynamics problems.
Students will have the necessary knowledge and skills for dynamic modeling of structures and will be able to model the dynamic behaviors of different structure types.
Students will learn different analysis methods for structural dynamics analysis and will be able to apply these methods through computer-aided software.
Students will be able to conduct project and research studies in the field of structural dynamics, identify existing problems, and develop solution proposals.
Students will develop oral and written communication skills to effectively communicate structural dynamics topics and will be able to collaborate in teamwork.

syllabus_topics: Formulation of dynamic models for discrete and continuous structures
Analysis of shocks and environmental loads (earthquakes, wind and waves)
Analysis and stability of structural components (beams and cables and large systems such as offshore towers, moored ships and floating platforms)
